title: Wicked
author: Gregory Maguire
summary: A retelling of The Wonderful Wizard of Oz from the viewpoint of the girl who becomes the Wicked Witch of the West. It follows her from a troubled birth through school and a political Oz that is not as happy as it seems.
readIf: you like revisionist fantasy that mixes satire, politics and moral questions about who gets called wicked.
skipIf: you want a light musical-style story, because the book is much darker and denser than the stage show.

pairings.reason: The original story that Wicked reimagines, and a quick read in its own right.
Another retelling that gives a vilified woman a voice and a full inner life.
Also a long, wry fantasy novel that treats magic with a satirist’s eye.
